messages:
olivia_csm: Quick weekly pulse for HelixApps — usage +12% wk/wk, spend flat. Main concern: streaming routes showing higher tail latency (p95/p99) vs non-streaming. Posting top-line numbers and a link to the dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/helix-ops. Can we confirm cause and mitigation?
liam_data: Numbers snapshot (24h):
- search | streaming | p95=520ms -> p95 prev=420ms, p99=2.4s -> prev=1.9s
- search | sync     | p95=260ms, p99=480ms
- summarize | streaming | p95=610ms, p99=3.4s (spike 2026-03-18T14:00UTC)
- summarize | sync       | p95=300ms, p99=600ms
Link to raw query: https://redwood.internal/queries/9987
kevin_eng: I saw a config change rolled yesterday to the dedicated pool aimed at cost tuning — `BATCH_MAX_LATENCY_MS` increased from 50 -> 100. That can increase tail for streaming because it prioritizes larger batches over immediate sends. Rolling a canary rollback now.
devon_sre: Observability note: KV cache miss rate up from 12% -> 29% on streaming sessions for model `summarize-compact-v2`. Also more short-lived connections in us-west-2 during the spike window. Might be correlated.
olivia_csm: Helix is sensitive to 99th pct for renewals. Can we get an ETA on rollback verification? cc @kevin_eng @devon_sre
kevin_eng: Canary rollback executed (canary pool). Monitoring 30m — if p99 improves we'll push global rollback. ETA ~2h. :mechanic:
liam_data: I'll add a focused widget to the CS dashboard showing p95/p99 split by route, model, and mode (streaming vs sync). Query I'm using for the widget: `SELECT route, model, mode, percentile_latency(0.95) AS p95, percentile_latency(0.99) AS p99 FROM inference_metrics WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY route, model, mode`
latency-bot: Alert: HelixApps streaming-search p99 exceeded 2s at 2026-03-18T14:03:22Z — auto-created incident #INC-4821
olivia_csm: Good context. Please post a short customer-facing blurb we can share after verification.
kevin_eng: Verification update: canary rollback shows streaming-search p99 dropped from 2.4s -> 1.1s within 18 minutes after revert. P95 also back to expected range. Preparing a short note: "We identified a batching config change that temporarily increased tail latency for streaming routes; we reverted the change and are monitoring — metrics have returned to baseline."
olivia_csm: Perfect, I'll include that in the Helix renewal touch today and attach the dashboard widget once liam pushes it. Closing this thread unless we see a regression. :thumbsup:
